title: IT / Finance / Security Admin Sync
summary: Weekly admin sync covering SOC 2 prep, KMS key rotation schedule, finance chargeback for dedicated capacity, and procurement timing for end-of-year renewals. Agreed next steps: share SOC2 gap doc, finance to send updated chargeback spreadsheet, IT to confirm KMS rotation dates and vendor invoices, schedule follow-up next week.
topics: KMS/HSM rotation and onboarding for private deployments
Chargeback / cost allocation for Dedicated instances and cloud spend
SSO/SAML and audit log retention policy
action_items: Olivia Chen:Send updated chargeback spreadsheet to group:2026-12-09
Daniel Park:Confirm KMS rotation window and share runbook:2026-12-08
Maya Singh:Attach SOC2 gap tracker and evidence list:2026-12-07
Jorge Martinez:Consolidate vendor invoice status for renewals:2026-12-10
next_steps: Samantha to circulate meeting notes + link to SOC2 gap doc
Schedule 30m follow-up next Wednesday to review chargeback numbers
IT to run smoke test of rotation on staging KMS and report back
Procurement to lock vendor pricing and requested PO templates
transcript:
[00:00] Samantha Ortiz: alright folks, thanks for joining, i think we've got everyone, uh let's kick off the admin sync. agenda is SOC2, kms rotation, finance chargebacks and procurement timing.
[00:18] Tom Weber: yep that's right, we've got a couple vendors to reconcile, and the audit window is closing fast, so want to make sure evidence is lining up.
[00:30] Olivia Chen: quick note, finance needs the dedicated capacity breakdown by team so we can do chargebacks before EOY, otherwise the POs get delayed.
[00:45] Evan Liu: yeah I'll need per-cluster and per-project run rates, plus any forecasted bursts.
[00:58] Daniel Park: on the KMS side, we're planning a rotation next month, but need to confirm the maintenance window. we don't want to impact private deployments that have customer-managed keys.
[01:12] Maya Singh: also need to capture proof of rotation for SOC2 \u2014 screenshots, logs, who approved \u2014 that kind of evidence. sometimes the transcriptions make names weird but the auditor wants chain of custody.
[01:30] Samantha Ortiz: sounds good. Maya, can you share the gap tracker after the call? even a short list of outstanding artifacts will help.
[01:42] Maya Singh: yeah i'll export the tracker; i have notes on env access reviews, stale accounts, and the log retention policy. i'll include a note on SAML metadata rotation too.
[01:57] Rina Patel: about log retention, are we aligned on 13 months for audit logs? last time procurement asked for 12, so just checking.
[02:10] Jorge Martinez: procurement's preference was 12 but compliance asked for 13, we can raise to 13 but need to confirm storage cost impact.
[02:22] Olivia Chen: cost is fine if it's justified, just put the delta in the chargeback sheet.
[02:30] Daniel Park: regarding KMS, quick technical detail, we have separate KMS keys per account in prod, staging uses a shared cmk, so rotation there is non-disruptive, prod window has zero-downtime plan but we need to run a smoke test.
[02:48] Tom Weber: how long is the maintenance window? do we have an estimate in minutes?
[02:53] Daniel Park: estimate 20-30 minutes per region for key rollover, but it depends on cache TTLs \u2014 kv cache can hold old keys for a minute, so we must flush caches and restart a few services.
[03:06] Olivia Chen: service restarts... any risk of billing spikes during restart?
[03:11] Evan Liu: unlikely but there could be short-lived retries that increase tokens. we'll factor it into the chargeback for that day.
[03:21] Samantha Ortiz: okay, finance needs the per-project spike estimate; Evan can we assume 10% surge for planning?
[03:28] Evan Liu: 10% conservative, okay.
[03:31] Samantha Ortiz: perfect. next, procurement: Jorge, status on vendor invoices and renewals?
[03:39] Jorge Martinez: getting final quotes, some vendors pushed pricing until Jan, i'm compiling PO templates and will flag anything that needs exec signature.
[03:48] Rina Patel: vendors that touch customer data \u2014 we need updated contracts with data processing addendum and binding clauses for EU regions.
[03:58] Tom Weber: yes, and for private deployments customers want KMS/HSM attestation; we've had one request for on-prem key escrow, so need procurement to capture that.
[04:09] Jorge Martinez: noted. i'll add a checklist for data processing addenda and HSM attestation docs.
[04:16] Samantha Ortiz: good, and the SOC2 list \u2014 Maya, any blockers left on evidence collection?
[04:24] Maya Singh: mainly access review evidence: need receipts from app owners confirming account removals and a few signed policy docs. also need details on encryption at rest for certain storage buckets; some names in the exports are wrong so i'll map them to canonical names.
[04:40] Daniel Park: on the tech ops side we'll produce the storage encryption report and provide S3 bucket config screenshots.
[04:48] Olivia Chen: finance will expect that by EOD Monday to close books on any remediation spend.
[04:54] Samantha Ortiz: ok set expectation \u2014 Maya and Daniel, can you get those artifacts by Monday?
[05:00] Daniel Park: yes.
[05:02] Maya Singh: i'll aim for Monday morning.
[05:05] Tom Weber: one more item \u2014 SSO metadata rotation. Okta is renewing certs next month, we need to ensure the metadata endpoint is updated and test logins.
[05:17] Daniel Park: i'll pull the integration playbook \u2014 there was a weird case last time where the logout endpoints broke, so we'll smoke test SSO in staging first.
[05:27] Samantha Ortiz: great. any blocker on chargeback spreadsheet? Olivia?
[05:32] Olivia Chen: i'll consolidate numbers from payroll and infra and send spreadsheet by Thursday EOD.
[05:38] Evan Liu: i'll annotate the sheet with per-route token rates and typical sequence lengths, that helps make chargebacks fair.
[05:46] Samantha Ortiz: perfect. to recap \u2014 action items: finance sends chargeback sheet, IT confirm KMS rotation window and runbook, security sends SOC2 gap tracker and artifacts, procurement consolidates vendor invoices. schedule follow-up next Wednesday.
[06:05] Jorge Martinez: quick question \u2014 do we want to involve legal on the data addenda now or after procurement compiles?
[06:12] Rina Patel: probably now; legal can pre-review templates to speed signoff.
[06:17] Samantha Ortiz: ok i'll loop in legal after this call.
[06:21] Tom Weber: minor transcription note: sometimes the auto transcript munges KMS to "kmses" or KV cache to "kv catch" \u2014 but internal logs will be correct.
[06:33] Samantha Ortiz: yeah we've seen that. alright if no other items, thanks everyone. we'll send notes and next steps.
[06:43] Olivia Chen: thanks all.
[06:46] End of recording.
